method: Linux Chromium production preview, healthy desktop CPU/storage; 20 ms main-thread heartbeat during real file import and durable commit; exact stored command comparison and reload
limits: Worker moves semantic audit off the interface thread; it does not reduce replay complexity. Serialization, cloning and rendering still use the main thread. This is not a physical-device acceptance or a 20,000-command performance claim. Validation has a 20-second per-request deadline; oversized/incompatible data is rejected without writes.
